# Programme Mandate: One Acme Customer Portal (FICTIONAL - executive committee decision, 15 September 2026)

## Objective
Replace portals A, B and C with one customer portal and one customer record, fully in Dutch and French (English optional), by 31 December 2028.

## Scope
- In: customer login, tracking, parcel and freight booking, returns, invoice and proof-of-delivery documents, temperature views for cold chain customers, customer user management, the customer service agent view, migration and switch-off of A, B and C.
- Out: replacing the TMS systems, SAP S/4HANA or the CRMs; pricing changes; driver apps.

## Milestones
- Discovery complete and platform chosen: 31 March 2027
- Decision on a 12-month TrackBox extension instead of a 3-year renewal: 31 December 2026
- Portal B customers migrated before the Liferay hosting ends: 30 June 2027
- Portal C customers migrated: 31 March 2028
- Portal A customers migrated: 30 June 2028
- All legacy portals switched off: 31 December 2028

## Targets
- Portal run cost down at least 35% (baseline EUR 1.31M per year)
- "Where is my shipment?" calls down 40%
- Average handling time down 25%; first-contact resolution at least 80%
- 100% of data subject requests answered within one month
- MFA for all users, mandatory for business administrators

## Governance
- Sponsor: Annelies Claes (COO). Design authority: Architecture Board. Monthly steering committee.
